title: BIM Engineer - Electrical
description:
# Electrical BIM Modeler / BIM Coordinator

**Company:** Tejsheel Private Limited (Tejsheel BIM Studio)
**Job Location:** Pune, Maharashtra
**Employment Type:** Full-Time
**Experience:** 2–5 Years (Preferred)
**Project Type:** US Electrical BIM – LOD 400
**Department:** BIM – Electrical
**Work Mode:** As per company requirements

## About Tejsheel BIM Studio

Tejsheel BIM Studio is a Pune-based BIM consultancy providing Building Information Modelling services across Architectural, Structural, and MEPF disciplines. We deliver coordinated, construction-ready BIM models and documentation for projects in India and international markets.

We are looking for a skilled and detail-oriented **Electrical BIM Modeler / BIM Coordinator** to join our team and work on US-based electrical projects. The candidate will be responsible for developing LOD 400 electrical BIM models, coordinating electrical systems with other disciplines, and preparing accurate, installation-ready shop drawings.

## Key Responsibilities

* Develop and maintain electrical BIM models in Autodesk Revit based on contract drawings, engineering drawings, redlines, markups, feeder matrices, and project specifications.
* Model electrical conduits, conduit racks, cable trays, electrical equipment, hangers, supports, and associated electrical systems.
* Develop coordinated conduit routing and consolidate conduit racks to optimize installation and minimize clashes.
* Perform model coordination and clash detection using Autodesk Navisworks.
* Coordinate electrical systems with Architectural, Structural, Mechanical, Plumbing, and other relevant disciplines.
* Prepare coordinated electrical shop drawings, including:

  * Conduit layout drawings.
  * Conduit rack and hanger layout drawings.
  * Electrical equipment layout drawings.
  * Lighting layout drawings.
  * Penetration drawings.
  * Other electrical installation and coordination drawings.
* Interpret engineering drawings, redlines, markups, and technical specifications independently.
* Identify discrepancies, modelling constraints, and coordination issues and seek clarification when required.
* Maintain model accuracy, drawing quality, and compliance with project requirements.
* Provide daily progress updates and communicate proactively with project stakeholders.
* Respond promptly to project communications through email and Microsoft Teams.
* Meet agreed production schedules, submission deadlines, and quality standards.
* Maintain strict confidentiality and comply with project-specific information security requirements.

Responsibilities:
## Professional Expectations

The selected candidate must demonstrate:

* Ownership of assigned modelling and documentation tasks.
* Proactive communication regarding technical issues and project progress.
* Responsiveness to emails and Microsoft Teams messages.
* Ability to work collaboratively with project teams and meet deadlines.
* Commitment to model quality, drawing accuracy, and coordination standards.
* Professional conduct when handling confidential project information.

## What We Are Looking For

We are seeking a candidate who can independently interpret electrical drawings, develop accurate LOD 400 BIM models, resolve coordination issues, and deliver high-quality electrical shop drawings with minimal supervision.

**Interested candidates:** Please share your updated CV along with details of your Revit, eVolve Electrical, Navisworks, US project, and LOD 400 experience.

Requirements:
## Required Technical Skills

* Strong hands-on experience in Autodesk Revit for electrical BIM modelling.
* Working knowledge of eVolve Electrical.
* Experience with Autodesk Navisworks for model coordination and clash detection.
* Basic understanding of electrical systems, construction practices, and electrical installation documentation.
* Ability to interpret electrical engineering drawings, redlines, markups, and specifications.
* Understanding of conduit routing, cable trays, electrical equipment layouts, and supports.
* Ability to prepare coordinated electrical shop drawings.
* Good problem-solving, coordination, and communication skills.

## Preferred Qualifications

* Diploma or Degree in Electrical Engineering or a related technical discipline.
* Experience working on US-based electrical BIM projects.
* Experience with LOD 400 electrical modelling and construction documentation.
* Exposure to data centers, hospitals, commercial buildings, or other mission-critical projects.
* Familiarity with US electrical construction drawings and documentation standards.

## Software and Tools

The following software licenses will be provided by Tejsheel BIM Studio, as required for the project:

* Autodesk Revit / Autodesk AEC Collection.
* Autodesk BIM Collaborate Pro.
* Bluebeam Revu.
* eVolve Electrical.
* Autodesk Navisworks.

title: BIM ENGINEER
description:
We are looking for a enthusiastic and detail-oriented BIM Engineer with 0-1  years of hands-on experience to join our technical team in Pune. In this role, you will be responsible for creating, managing, and coordinating multidisciplinary 3D BIM models (Architectural, Structural) throughout various project stages.

You will collaborate closely with Architects, Structural Engineers, , and Project Managers to ensure design accuracy, conduct clash detection, and produce construction-ready documentation in compliance with ISO 19650 standards and project BIM Execution Plans (BEP).

Responsibilities:
3D BIM Modeling: Create and update accurate Architectural, Structural, or MEP models in Autodesk Revit as per project guidelines.

Clash Resolution: Run clash detection tests in Navisworks, identify design conflicts, and coordinate with teams to resolve them.

Drawing Extraction: Generate accurate 2D CAD drawings, floor plans, sections, and material schedules directly from BIM models.

Model Quality Checks: Perform quality control on models to ensure correct naming conventions, worksets, and modeling standards.

Team Coordination: Upload and manage project files on Autodesk Construction Cloud (ACC/BIM 360) and support Senior BIM Coordinators.

Requirements:
Autodesk Revit (Architecture / Structure /):

Strong proficiency in 3D modeling, central file worksharing, worksets, and basic parametric family creation.
Autodesk Navisworks Manage
Hands-on experience with clash detection, clash matrix setup, and report generation.
Proficient in 2D drafting, CAD cleanup, and CAD-to-BIM conversion.

title: BIM Architectural Modeler
description:
About Us:
At UBP we are a leading BIM service provider working on diverse projects across the Sweden, UK, UAE, France, Australia, Netherlands and Canada. We specialize in delivering high-quality architectural modelling, restoration, facility management, and Scan-to-BIM services. Join our growing team of passionate professionals dedicated to shaping the future of digital construction. 

Job Description:
 We are seeking a motivated and detail-oriented Junior BIM Architect with a minimum of 1 year of hands-on experience in Autodesk Revit. 
The ideal candidate should have an academic background in B.Arch., Diploma in Architecture, or a related field in the AEC industry. 

Required Skills & Qualifications:
  Educational Qualification: B.Arch. / Diploma in Architecture / related field in the AEC industry. 
 Minimum 1 year of working experience in Autodesk Revit. 
 Sound understanding of architectural modelling standards and BIM workflows. 
 Proficient in topography modelling and working with site-related elements. 
 Experience in working with central files and BIM 360 for team collaboration.
  Knowledge of sheet setup, detailing, and annotation standards. 
 Familiarity with phases and design options in Revit. 
 Strong attention to detail and a commitment to high-quality deliverables.
  Preferred Qualifications (Good to Have)
 Understanding of AutoCAD Software. 
 Experience in international projects (US/UK/UAE/Australia/Canada) is advantage.

Responsibilities:
Key Responsibilities: 
 Develop accurate and detailed architectural BIM models using Autodesk Revit.
  Model topography and architectural elements based on provided data and project requirements. 
 Understand and follow architecture discipline standards and coordination workflows. 
 Work efficiently in a central model environment and collaborate through BIM 360. 
 Prepare sheet layouts, annotations, and presentation drawings according to project standards.
  Handle phasing work for renovation/restoration and new construction projects. 
 Coordinate with project leads and follow defined BIM execution plans.

Requirements:
Technical & Modeling Skills

• Architectural Modeling: Building intelligent 3D components—including walls, curtain walls, floors, roofs, ceilings, and stairs—with correct parametric constraints.
• Family & Object Creation: Developing custom parametric 2D/3D BIM families and components.
• Documentation Production: Extracting accurate plans, sections, elevations, schedules, and detailed construction sheets straight from the model.
• Data Management: Embedding non-graphic metadata (such as material specs, fire ratings, and manufacturer data) and exporting schedules to Excel.
• Quality Control (QC): Performing model audits, checking worksets, managing file naming conventions, and cleaning up views

title: MEPF BIM Modeler
description:
The MEPF BIM Modeler is responsible for developing, updating, and coordinating accurate BIM models for Mechanical, Electrical, Plumbing, and Fire Fighting (MEPF) systems.
The role ensures that MEPF models are execution-ready, clash-free, and compliant with BIM standards and project requirements.
The MEPF BIM Modeler supports interdisciplinary coordination, documentation, and construction outputs through high-quality BIM modeling.

Responsibilities:
1. MEPF BIM Model Development
•	Develop detailed MEPF BIM models in Autodesk Revit as per drawings, specifications, and BEP
•	Model Mechanical, Electrical, Plumbing, and Fire Fighting systems accurately
•	Maintain required Level of Development (LOD) as per project stage
•	Ensure models are suitable for coordination and construction use

2. Model Quality, Accuracy & Standards
•	Ensure accuracy and completeness of MEPF BIM models
•	Follow company BIM standards, templates, and naming conventions
•	Ensure correct use of levels, grids, coordinates, and worksets
•	Prevent modeling errors and inconsistencies

3. Inter-Discipline Coordination & Clash Support
•	Coordinate MEPF models with Architectural and Structural BIM models
•	Participate in clash detection using Navisworks
•	Implement approved clash resolutions
•	Support coordination reviews and meetings

4. Drawing, Quantity & Output Preparation
•	Prepare coordinated layouts, shop drawings, and construction drawings
•	Extract quantities, schedules, and BOQs from BIM models
•	Ensure drawings are clear, accurate, and execution-ready

5. Change Management & Version Control
•	Update models based on design changes, RFIs, and site inputs
•	Ensure proper version control and file management
•	Prevent usage of outdated models and drawings

6. Productivity & Timelines
•	Complete assigned modeling tasks within agreed timelines
•	Meet internal and client delivery schedules
•	Maintain consistent output without compromising quality

7. Coordination with Team & Stakeholders
•	Coordinate with BIM Coordinators and Team Leads
•	Clarify BIM-related technical queries
•	Support interdisciplinary coordination requirements

8. Reporting & Task Updates
•	Submit regular task progress updates
•	Highlight risks or delays impacting deliverables
•	Maintain task logs and revision records

9. Continuous Improvement & Skill Development
•	Upgrade BIM skills, tools, and workflows
•	Follow best practices in BIM modeling
•	Support process improvements and automation initiatives

10. Client Coordination, Site Support & Team Development
•	Attend client meetings and client office visits for project discussions and progress reviews. 
•	Coordinate with clients, consultants, contractors, and internal teams to ensure smooth project execution. 
•	Conduct site visits as required by the client for verification, issue resolution, and project support. 
•	Lead and guide junior BIM modelers in daily project activities. 
•	Provide technical training, mentoring, and knowledge-sharing sessions to team members. 
•	Support resource planning and ensure timely completion of assigned deliverables.

Requirements:
Revit & BIM Standards, AutoCAD & Civil 3D, Navisworks Clash Detection etc....
